sources.entry: Dorothy - Desktop app to orchestrate multiple AI CLI agents simultaneously with automations, Kanban management, and remote control via Telegram.
Dorothy - Open-source desktop app to orchestrate multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) simultaneously with automations, Kanban management, and remote control.

summary.one_liner: Dorothy is a free, open-source Electron desktop app for running and coordinating multiple AI coding CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, local agents) in parallel, with automations, a Kanban board, and remote control via Telegram and Slack.
summary.what_it_does: Runs many agent CLI sessions at once, each in its own PTY terminal, with per-agent skills, model choice, project paths, and persisted state across restarts. A Super Agent uses MCP tools to create, start, stop, and monitor other agents. Automations poll GitHub (via the gh CLI) and JIRA, then spawn a temporary agent per new or updated item using templated prompts. A Kanban board (Backlog, Planned, Ongoing, Done) auto-assigns tasks to agents by skill match. The README also describes cron-based scheduled tasks, a Vault document store with full-text search, SocialData Twitter/X tools, and Google Workspace access via the gws CLI, exposed through five MCP servers.
use_cases: Run multiple AI coding agents across several projects at once
Automate PR or issue review with an AI agent
Process JIRA issues automatically with agents
Control coding agents remotely from Telegram or Slack
Schedule recurring Claude Code tasks on a cron schedule
Manage agent work on a visual Kanban board
notable: Super Agent orchestrates other agents through MCP tools, including temporary agents that are cleaned up after use
Kanban automation service matches tasks to agents by skill and creates agents when none fit
Automations poll sources, deduplicate by content hash, and deliver output back to Telegram, Slack, GitHub, or JIRA
Vault gives agents a shared, searchable markdown knowledge base backed by SQLite FTS5
Five MCP servers (orchestrator, telegram, kanban, vault, socialdata) communicate over stdio
caveats: Requires the Claude Code CLI and GitHub CLI (gh) for GitHub automations; Node.js 18+ is needed to build from source
Open agent management and terminal features require the Electron app; the web browser mode does not support them
Several automation sources (Pipedrive, Twitter, RSS, custom) are listed as planned, not active; Google Workspace and SocialData need separate accounts or API keys
macOS users may need to clear quarantine with xattr before first launch; scheduled tasks use launchd on macOS and cron on Linux
keywords: manage several ai agents at once
remote control ai agents from phone
